column1: # MAST repo manifest -- single source of truth for mast-clone.sh and mast-clone.ps1.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   dir     Folder name created under <Top>. This name is load-bearing: the
#           'common' folder MUST be named exactly 'common', because MAST_common's
#           repo root IS the 'common' package (it has a root __init__.py). With
#           <Top> on sys.path, 'from common.X import ...' then resolves with no
#           source changes. Naming it 'MAST_common' breaks every import.
#   repo    GitHub repository name under the The-MAST-project org.
#   roles   Comma-separated roles that pull this repo. 'all' pulls every row.
#   branch  Branch to check out. MUST be explicit -- see below.
# WHY BRANCH IS PINNED AND NOT LEFT TO THE REMOTE DEFAULT:
# Two repos have a GitHub default branch that is an abandoned stub:
#   MAST_common   default HEAD = main (2 commits, last 2024-12-28); real work is
#                 on master (721 commits). The .gitmodules in control/gui/spec/unit
#                 all pin 'branch = master', corroborating this.
#   MAST_control  default HEAD = main (2 commits, last 2024-04-26); real work is
#                 on master (148 commits).
# A plain 'git clone' of either lands on the stub and silently produces a nearly
# empty checkout -- for common that means no __init__.py, so every
# 'from common.X import ...' in the fleet fails with ModuleNotFoundError.
# Fix the GitHub default branches and this column can relax; until then it is
# the only thing standing between a provisioning run and a broken unit.
# Adding a repo: add a row here only. Neither script hardcodes a repo list.
# PINNED TOOL VERSIONS
# Directive lines start with '#!' and are parsed by both scripts. They are
# comments to anything else that reads this file.
# uv-version: the uv release used by --bootstrap-uv / -BootstrapUv. Pinned for
# the same reason the branches are: an unpinned bootstrap installs whatever is
# current that day, so two machines provisioned a month apart get different
# resolvers and the fleet drifts -- which is what these scripts exist to stop.
# Bump this line to move the fleet; the download is checksum-verified against
# the .sha256 GitHub publishes beside each artifact.
#!uv-version
# dir
common
unit
control
gui
spec
claude
